design_decisions: POST_GAME_SETTLE_QUIET_WINDOW_SECONDS is 3.0 seconds only for the post-game settled decision. Seven captured local-activity bursts spread 0.051 to 0.111 seconds, giving roughly 30x margin, and values below about 6.5 seconds are equivalent because first-peer confirmation binds first.

Pre-game settlement remains on the existing fifteen-second window because it gates launch and releasing it early could start a game before a newer incoming save lands. The reported local recency flags and local and remote pruning also retain their fifteen-second semantics.

Extended post-game observation is selected from the persisted debug_logging value captured at watch start. Logger levels are deliberately not a signal: setup_logging() pins sdh_ludusavi to DEBUG permanently while the UI setting adjusts only decky.logger filtering.
No README.md change is needed. SYNCTHING COMPLETE has the same user-facing meaning, and Debug Logging now behaves as its existing description claimed rather than introducing a new option.

deferred_verification: A post-game Steam Deck run is required. The expected signature is SYNCTHING COMPLETE roughly 8 seconds after SYNCTHING UPLOADING rather than roughly 17 seconds, with handoff-to-complete near 19 seconds rather than the 27.4-second 2026-08-11 baseline.

The latch diagnostic must establish whether extended observation is selected on device. The 2026-08-11 case in which observation did not run despite an always-true logger-level gate remains unexplained; this branch supplies a correct gate and diagnostic, not a fix for that separate failure.
The three-second window is calibrated from one Wobbly Life save of roughly 1.4 MB across 111 files. A larger save could scan longer and may require a separate calibration.
The unchanged 90-second stall window, 900-second backend hard ceiling, and 300-second frontend no-evidence ceiling remain unexercised on device.
